title: 1906 Prairie's brick barn on the alley
items: The alley building behind 1906 Prairie Avenue, the Edson Keith house, is no longer a rough draft. It now stands as a two-storey brick barn, 19.9 m along the alley and 9.1 m deep, with a one-storey brick range running on 10.6 m south of it, both drawn from the 1911 fire-insurance map. The rough draft stood one block, 1 m off the alley.
Windows sit where the map marks one in each part, beside two carriage doors and a hay-loft hatch. A paved walk runs from the yard door to the house's two-storey back wing.
The doors, roof pitch and most windows are reconstructed, and they are listed on the building's card.
